name: Conversion Propensity Model
task: Predict approved purchases per click from ad-funnel signals

features.label: Impression volume vs median
features.what: Delivery scale relative to the median ad.
features.why: Heavily-delivered ads reach colder audiences; small ads are usually tightly targeted.
features.effect: Moving from a low (25th pct) to a high (75th pct) value lowers the predicted conversion rate by 84.61 approved purchases per 1,000 clicks, on average.

features.label: Click-through rate (log)
features.what: Share of impressions that become clicks, on a log scale.
features.why: A creative that attracts clicks is relevant to its audience; relevance travels with purchase intent.
features.effect: Moving from a low (25th pct) to a high (75th pct) value lowers the predicted conversion rate by 6.53 approved purchases per 1,000 clicks, on average.

features.label: Cost per 1,000 impressions vs median (log)
features.what: Auction price of reach relative to the portfolio median.
features.why: Signals audience scarcity/quality and platform competition.
features.effect: Moving from a low (25th pct) to a high (75th pct) value lowers the predicted conversion rate by 10.73 approved purchases per 1,000 clicks, on average.

features.label: Cost per click vs portfolio median (log)
features.what: How expensive a click is relative to the median ad in the same portfolio.
features.why: Expensive clicks come from competitive, high-intent auctions; very cheap clicks are often low-intent traffic.
features.effect: Moving from a low (25th pct) to a high (75th pct) value raises the predicted conversion rate by 2.37 approved purchases per 1,000 clicks, on average.

honest_reading: Weak but measurable: out-of-fold deviance is 6.79% below a constant-rate baseline (rank correlation 0.10). Impression volume vs median carries 92% of the importance, so most of the signal is one feature. Public data for some brands is thin. That is why the engine takes only 35% of the relative signal, clipped to 0.85–1.15×, and the deterministic CFO still decides.
